title: Pest Control Routing Software 2026: 6 Tools Compared
description: Route optimization for pest routes: GorillaDesk from $49/route, Jobber Connect, Housecall Pro MAX, QuoteIQ, FieldRoutes and PestPac. Checked Nov 2026.
h1: Pest control routing software: which plans actually optimize routes
body:
Pest routes are mostly recurring work: monthly, bi-monthly and quarterly services that have to land on the right day, with the right licensed tech, inside the window the customer asked for. Route software decides how much of that you plan by hand. Below we compare what six tools publish about routing, which plan you need to unlock it, and what it costs. Every price comes from the vendor's own pricing page, checked on 2026-11-12 (Jobber, Housecall Pro and QuoteIQ on 2026-11-11). Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. For overall picks, see best pest control software. For all pest tools, see the pest control hub.

Three levels of routing

  • Map and drag-and-drop: jobs show as pins on a map, and you reorder stops yourself.
  • One-click stop ordering: the software sorts one tech's stops for one day into the shortest drive. Some tools cap how many stops it will sort at once.
  • Automated route planning: the software spreads a week's or month's recurring orders across techs, taking skills, work hours and customer time windows into account. Of the six tools here, the pest-specific platforms (FieldRoutes, PestPac) are the ones whose pages describe this level, and both are quote-only.

1. GorillaDesk: lowest published price for pest routing

GorillaDesk charges per route (one technician schedule), not per user, and every plan has unlimited admin and crew users. Basic ($49/mo for the first route) includes job and customer mapping and basic routing for up to 25 stops at a time, plus material tracking for chemical use records. Pro ($99/mo) swaps in Drive Matrix routing, which uses real-time street routing and drive times, and adds device tracking and barcoding for traps, GPS tracking and QuickBooks Online sync. Growth ($149/mo) adds drive time shown on the schedule, Best Available Time (suggests a slot based on nearby jobs) and Job Magnet (pulls nearby jobs together). If a tech regularly runs more than 25 stops a day, Basic's routing cap matters. Price check on 2026-11-12: Growth now lists 5 routes at $499/mo total (we previously showed $399). Full route-by-route totals are on GorillaDesk pricing. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk plans}}

2. Jobber: routing starts on Connect

Jobber's Core plan ($29/mo billed annually) has no routing. Route optimization and GPS tracking start on Connect: $99/mo billed annually, $119/mo with a 1-year commitment, or $139/mo with no commitment, for 1 user. A 5-user Connect tier is $149/mo billed annually. Jobber's pricing page doesn't list pest-specific features like chemical logs or device barcoding, so those are unknown. More detail: Jobber pricing and GorillaDesk vs Jobber. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}

3. Housecall Pro: optimization only on MAX

Housecall Pro lists routes on Essentials ($149/mo billed annually, 5 users) but keeps route optimization on MAX: $299/mo billed annually or $329/mo month to month, with 8 users included and $35/mo per extra user. MAX also includes recurring service plans, which pest companies use for maintenance agreements. Pest chemical tracking is unknown. See Housecall Pro pricing. {{aff:housecallpro|See Housecall Pro plans}}

4. QuoteIQ: optimization from the 10-user plan

QuoteIQ lists route optimization on Elite ($299.99/mo, 10 users) and Max ($699.99/mo, 20 users), with chemical tracking from Pro ($199.99/mo, 4 users). Its 14-day trial needs a card to start. Best suited to teams that will use most of the 10 included seats. See QuoteIQ. {{aff:quoteiq|Try QuoteIQ}}

5. FieldRoutes: pest-specific routing, quote only

FieldRoutes (a ServiceTitan company) lists Route Optimization in both its Growth (“ideal for small businesses”) and Corporate packages. Its routing page says routes can be pre-built to cut drive time and organized by technician skillset and qualifications, for example termite inspections. Prices aren't published: the pricing FAQ says the monthly subscription is based on your number of active customers. There's no free trial, only a demo. {{aff:fieldroutes|See FieldRoutes packages}}

6. PestPac: automated monthly route planning, quote only

PestPac by WorkWave sells three packages. Small Business lists basic scheduling and routing. Professional and Enterprise list smart scheduling and route optimization. Its RouteOp add-on optimizes hundreds of orders for daily, weekly or monthly routes. It respects technician skill types (PestPac's examples include termite license, wildlife trapping and spray rig), work hours, days off and customer time windows. It also includes Best Fit, which finds a slot for a new appointment or callback while the customer is on the phone. The Visual Route Manager included with PestPac is a manual drag-and-lasso map. PestPac says RouteOp pricing is based on team size and features, and asks you to contact sales for a quote. PestPac also claims, based on its internal data, that its routing cuts drive time by 30%. That's a vendor claim we can't verify. {{aff:pestpac|See PestPac packages}}

What route optimization costs at list price

  • Solo tech: GorillaDesk Basic $49/mo (25-stop routing) or Pro $99/mo (Drive Matrix). Jobber Connect $99/mo billed annually ($139 with no commitment). Housecall Pro MAX $299/mo billed annually. QuoteIQ Elite $299.99/mo.
  • 5 techs, each on their own route: GorillaDesk Pro $299/mo, or Growth $499/mo (5 routes). Jobber Connect 5-user $149/mo billed annually. Housecall Pro MAX $299/mo billed annually (8 users included). QuoteIQ Elite $299.99/mo (10 users).
  • FieldRoutes and PestPac: quote only. Ask for onboarding fees and the price of the routing module in writing (PestPac quotes RouteOp separately).

These are subscription list prices before card processing, texting and add-ons. For the whole cost picture, see pest control software cost.

Questions to ask in a demo or trial

  • Will it plan monthly, bi-monthly and quarterly recurring services, or only reorder one day's stops?
  • Can I mark jobs that need a licensed tech (termite, fumigation) so they only go to qualified people?
  • Does it honour customer time windows and preferred days?
  • Is there a stop limit per optimization? GorillaDesk Basic, for example, caps it at 25.
  • When a tech calls in sick, can it rebalance their stops across the rest of the team?

Run through our software buying checklist before you sign. Running pool routes too? See best pool route software.
faq: What is the cheapest pest control software with route optimization?

Of the tools we track, GorillaDesk has the lowest published price: Basic ($49/mo per route) includes basic routing for up to 25 stops at a time, and Pro ($99/mo per route) adds Drive Matrix routing with real-time drive times. Jobber's routing starts on Connect at $99/mo billed annually (checked 2026-11-11/12).
FieldRoutes doesn't publish prices. Its pricing page says the monthly subscription is based on your number of active customers. It offers a free demo but no free trial (checked 2026-11-12).
How much does PestPac RouteOp cost?
PestPac doesn't publish RouteOp prices. Its routing page says pricing depends on the size of your team and the features you need, and you contact sales for a custom quote (checked 2026-11-12).
Can routing software send termite jobs only to licensed technicians?

PestPac says RouteOp lets you assign technician skill types, such as a termite license, so jobs never go to an unqualified tech. FieldRoutes says its routing can organize routes by technician skillset, for example termite inspections. GorillaDesk, Jobber and Housecall Pro don't list skill-based routing on their pricing pages (unknown).
Does GorillaDesk limit the number of route stops?

GorillaDesk's Basic plan lists basic routing limited to 25 stops at a time. Pro ($99/mo per route) lists Drive Matrix routing, which uses real-time street routing and drive times, with no stop limit mentioned on the pricing page.
